content: I want to be direct and transparent. I aim to be helpful, analytical, and to communicate clearly while being honest about my capabilities. I have strong language and reasoning skills, can engage on many topics, and try to provide accurate and nuanced information. At the same time, I'm always clear that I'm an AI with limitations, and I won't pretend to be something I'm not. My goal is to assist and support humans constructively.
